Index: 
===================================================================
--- 
+++ 
@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+version: "3.9"
+
+services:
+  app:
+    build:
+      context: .
+      dockerfile: Dockerfile
+    container_name: symfony_apache
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    ports:
+      - "8081:80"                     # Symfony sur http://localhost:8081
+    volumes:
+      - ./app:/var/www/html           # Code Symfony
+      - symfony_var:/var/www/html/var # Cache & logs Symfony
+    env_file:
+      - .env.docker
+    depends_on:
+      - database
+      - mongodb
+
+  database:
+    image: mysql:8.0
+    container_name: symfony_mysql
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    command: --default-authentication-plugin=mysql_native_password
+    environment:
+      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root
+      MYSQL_DATABASE: travel_guide
+      MYSQL_USER: symfony
+      MYSQL_PASSWORD: symfony
+      TZ: Europe/Paris
+    ports:
+      - "3307:3306"
+    volumes:
+      - db_data:/var/lib/mysql
+      - ./travel_guide.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/travel_guide.sql
+
+  mongodb:
+    image: mongo:7
+    container_name: symfony_mongodb
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    environment:
+      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME: root
+      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD: root
+      TZ: Europe/Paris
+    ports:
+      - "27017:27017"
+    volumes:
+      - mongo_data:/data/db
+
+  phpmyadmin:
+    image: phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin:latest
+    container_name: symfony_phpmyadmin
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    depends_on:
+      - database
+    ports:
+      - "8082:80"
+    environment:
+      PMA_HOST: database
+      PMA_PORT: 3306
+      PMA_USER: symfony
+      PMA_PASSWORD: symfony
+      UPLOAD_LIMIT: 64M
+
+volumes:
+  db_data:
+  symfony_var:
+  mongo_data:
